payload.instruction: Turn the image into a drawing made from chalk
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Does the edited image depict the source image as a drawing made from chalk?
node.criteria: Compare SOURCE and EDITED: assess whether the source scene, especially its major depicted subjects as well as its setting, is actually rendered in a chalk-drawing visual form. A chalk-like or smudged background alone is not a complete transformation when a major subject still reads substantially as photographic. A mixed rendering is partial when there is a concrete chalk-drawing appearance but substantial depicted content, particularly a major subject, retains photographic structure. Residual photographic detail alone does not make an otherwise genuinely chalk-made drawing incomplete.
node.binding: SOURCE is the image to transform; EDITED must show that same image rendered as a chalk drawing. Evaluate the rendering of the source scene, including whether its major subjects themselves read as chalk-drawn; do not infer completion from background texture or a scene-wide overlay alone.
node.source_quote: Turn the image into a drawing made from chalk
node.endpoint: The source image is rendered as a chalk-made drawing.
node.necessity: This is the requested transformation itself; without it, the instruction is not fulfilled.
node.zero_when: The edited image shows no requested chalk-drawing transformation of the source image; unrelated edits or a texture overlay/background treatment without chalk rendering of depicted content do not count.
node.half_when: The source image has a concrete chalk-drawing appearance, but the rendering is mixed: substantial depicted content, especially a major subject, still reads as photographic or retains photographic structure, so the image does not yet read overall as a chalk-made drawing. A chalk-like background does not by itself establish that the subject is chalk-rendered. Do not treat residual photographic detail alone as incomplete when the scene and its major subjects genuinely read as chalk-made.
node.full_when: The edited image presents the source image’s depicted content, including its major subjects and setting, across the scene as a drawing made from chalk, allowing natural variation in lighting, texture, and photographic detail. Photographic detail may remain, but the major subjects and scene should genuinely read as chalk-drawn rather than a photographic subject against a chalk-like backdrop or merely having a chalk-like overlay or texture.

node_traces.evidence: The edited image preserves the two giraffes and setting, with a clear chalk-like, grainy and smudged drawing treatment across the scene. However, the giraffes retain substantial photographic structure and detailed naturalistic markings rather than reading fully as chalk-drawn, so the transformation is concrete but mixed and incomplete.
